meta.description: Per-instrument assay turnaround (TAT) for observation delivery
notes: delay_hours and full_run_hours are physical and convert through the run's epoch duration (voyage.epoch_duration_hours)
delay_epochs is grid-native: 0 means the result is available in the epoch it was ordered
epoch_fraction < 1.0 delivers within the same epoch (sub-epoch assays)
long_read_verification with use_profile reads deployment profile turnaround
clinical_strain_typing is shipboard amplicon sequencing: library prep plus run, 18 h
